rs.innovation_approach: 将多实体定位作为检索动作的批量参数；通过短预算优先示范建立并行行为，以成功轨迹的历史最少轮数为逐题收紧边界，再对失败轨迹附加同族强教师的token蒸馏。
rs.key_step: 同时约束交互轮数tc和总检索次数ts，阻止把串行冗余变成单轮并行乱搜；成功与失败轨迹接受不同效率区间，只有失败轨迹接收OPD。
rs.why_non_obvious: 仅允许并行并不能抑制过检索；仅惩罚轮数会鼓励一次塞入大量查询，固定阈值又可能惩罚合理多跳。失败轨迹的统一结果信号不能定位哪一个token错，但冻结教师能否帮助取决于其效率行为已对齐。
rs.trigger_condition: When independent sub-retrievals can be batched but accuracy-only optimization causes over-searching, apply joint round/invocation references and failure-gated aligned-teacher distillation to improve accuracy with fewer serial interactions.

rs.abstract_strategy: Fuse preparation and execution into a batched action; tighten per-instance resource references from successful attempts and correct only failed attempts with an aligned expert.
rs.abstract_key_step: Track both sequential depth and total work, rank outcomes within a group, and route dense expert matching only to unsuccessful completions.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Reducing depth can hide increasing total work; a generic expert may undo the efficient behavior learned by the student.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When decomposable requests still waste sequential interactions and failure labels obscure locally useful behavior, jointly bound depth and work and apply aligned-expert correction to failed completions.

evidence.quote:
Crucially, trajectories receive positive rewards only when falling in the strictly efficient region (tc ≤ t̂c
and ts ≤ t̂s ). Incorporating the ts constraint elegantly prevents reward hacking, a scenario where
the model minimizes interaction rounds by exhaustively spamming parallel calls within a single
turn.

signatures.failure_boundary: Reference ratchets can lock in lucky or contaminated successes; no certified minimal necessary calls; tc monotone does not imply ts monotone. Eq4 negative sign conflicts with signed λred in App.E. Unspecified equal-tc ties and no-success epoch handling.

signatures.information: Frozen RL-trained HyperEyes235B teacher and current student are conditioned on state st along the student rollout. Eq6 specifies no answer-key or privileged future context for teacher; full st serialization/multimodal packing and teacher request payload are not disclosed. Final correctness gates loss, rather than teacher per-call necessity labels.
signatures.operation: On GRPO-shared rollouts add mean reverse KL(student||frozen teacher) over completion tokens only when final Racc=0; retain GRPO branch; λkd=.05; no OPD for235B training.
signatures.output: Dense teacher-matching gradients in addition to trajectory-level GRPO gradients.
signatures.claimed_effect: Table5 aligned teacher improves TRACE62.7→64.0% at2.2 average turns; vanilla235B teacher gives46.3%/2.8. SFT-free TRACE+OPD gives44.7%/2.2 vs full64.0%/2.2.
conditions: Stronger same-family teacher already trained for parallel efficient search; SFT cold start supports desired behavior.
Teacher frozen, πold sampling-only, gradients through θ.

limitations.text: OPD needs stronger same-family teacher; cannot directly improve frontier-scale teacher with itself.
limitations.quote:
First, On-Policy Distillation requires a stronger same-family teacher, which inherently
bounds the student’s reasoning capabilities and prevents direct application at the frontier scale.

limitations.text: Only static images/text; no video/audio grounding tested.
limitations.quote:
Second, our parallel framework focuses exclusively on static image and text environments, lacking
the spatial-temporal grounding mechanisms necessary for dynamic modalities like video or audio.

limitations.text: Cross-method metrics mix toolchains and checkpoint scales.
limitations.quote:
VDR releases only an 8B supervised fine-tuning checkpoint, withholding the 30B model utilized in
its primary evaluations. Consequently, assessing these baselines requires navigating a fragmented
landscape of proprietary toolchains and missing model weights, which fundamentally limits the
comparability of the reported metrics.

question.observed_failure: Table5 outcome-only RL on30B raises average tool-call turns2.9→6.9 while average accuracy58.8→58.3%; vanilla-teacher OPD underperforms aligned teacher64.0 vs46.3.
question.load_bearing_assumption: Parallel action capability plus terminal correctness reward is sufficient for efficient search, and any stronger teacher supplies helpful token correction. Both fail in the reported ablations.
question.scope: Static image/text multimodal web search with decomposable multi-entity/multi-constraint queries and remaining legitimate multi-hop dependencies.
question.success_criterion: Increase six-benchmark accuracy while reducing sequential tool-call rounds; additionally CAS combines squared accuracy with token cost and rounds. This is not a preregistered statistical noninferiority criterion.
question.why_open: Existing serial crop-then-search interfaces accumulate rounds; correctness-only rewards do not distinguish efficient/redundant success; fixed reference thresholds cannot adapt per-query achievable efficiency, and failure rewards lack token detail.

objective.signal_routing: TRACE sums final correctness, schema penalty and trajectory cost before one group-relative advantage. Main text describes uniform token-level outcome credit; exact GRPO token-loss reduction/environment-token masking not specified. Eq6 adds failed-rollout-only reverse KL averaged over completion tokens; no per-call/region necessity gate, no replacement or masking of GRPO advantage, no OPD on successful trajectories or235B. Retrieved tool outputs are conditioning observations; exact exclusion from implemented completion mask is not shown and must not be invented.
objective.normalization: mean+std of aggregated scalar rewards within G=8; Eq5 additionally ranks tc over G and maps to positive/negative intervals; OPD token mean1/|A_tau|. No RLOO/no-std estimator. Sigma stabilization epsilon and rank ties undisclosed.
objective.invariance: TRACE is task-dependent reward modification, not potential-based shaping; no optimal-policy invariance theorem. Rank-only interpolation is invariant to tc changes preserving ranks/region membership; changing absolute tc or ts can cross thresholds. OPD success mask preserves zero explicit KL contribution for successes, not their learned behavior because parameters are shared. Whole-reward positive affine scaling cancels under exact mean/std, absent epsilon; additive efficiency coefficient is not generally invariant in mixed groups.
objective.baseline_or_potential: Group mean reward is the GRPO baseline. Per-query tc reference is historical minimum successful rollout cost; ts is attached invocation cost, not a learned value or necessity estimate. Frozen235B is a distillation teacher, not an answer-now counterfactual critic; no potential function.
objective.degenerate_cases: G=1 makes Eq5 denominator0. All-correct equal-format/region/rank-varying groups can retain efficiency gradients; rescaling their sole varying reward channel can be canceled by std. All-wrong groups may differ by tolerated vs penalized budgets/format; if every scalar reward equal sigma=0, numerical handling undisclosed, while failed-token OPD can still provide teacher mismatch signal. If all correct, OPD vanishes. Successful tc=0 gets tool reward0 (correctness1 remains), failure tc=0 below positive reference gets penalty with unresolved λ sign. At p(direct)≈0 no forced direct sampling restores support; no-search successes were filtered from data. If only one entity/serial dependency, batching offers little. tc lower bound and no-success epoch/tied-reference selection unspecified.

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Table5 isolates static vs updated reference, outcome-only vs TRACE, aligned vs vanilla teacher, and no-SFT variant. F.2 uses same3k QA/SFT hyperparameters, mutually converted UGS/Code-Crop trajectories, same judge and budget. F.3 uses48 shared-clean-correct Kimi trajectories with K=1/3/5/7/10 distractors and10 shuffles, isolating readout robustness rather than free agent search.
controls: Table4 compares121k PRS trajectories vs30k filtered data; data quality/size/turn distribution co-vary.
F.2 changes action representation; LLM-Crop adds external235B grounding, so wall-time/compute is not matched despite same training-example count.
F.3 evaluates235B SFT vs base, not TRACE RL or OPD; cannot attribute distractor robustness to RL.
Table2 uses original-paper accuracy but locally reproduced turns; Table6 reports separate local accuracy; VDR local checkpoint8B vs advertised30B results.

evidence_design.falsifier: Reader-proposed, not executed: hold backbone/search backend/checkpoint/token/call accounting fixed; compare static/adaptive references and shuffled references with matched cost; report per-query actual invocations and wall time. Teacher-gate comparison must match token/update compute; protect direct-capable and genuinely multi-hop strata separately.

pitfalls.text: Teacher alignment matters: larger vanilla model degrades distilled agent; use already TRACE-trained same-family teacher.
pitfalls.quote: Effective distillation strictly requires an efficiency-aligned teacher.

pitfalls.text: Prevent teacher from blocking async rollouts with separate service and bounded requests; no throughput benchmark given.
pitfalls.quote:
To prevent the teacher from becoming a bottleneck for asynchronous rollouts, we enforce a per-actor
connector limit of 32 concurrent requests and a 500-second timeout.

engineering.lesson: 当独立搜索可并行时，应分别记录交互轮数、底层检索次数、生成token与实测耗时；只奖励少轮数可能把浪费藏进批内调用。对失败样本加教师蒸馏前，应检验教师是否具备同样的效率行为，保留原结果信用并审计完整token mask。

measurement_and_source_audit.unit_contract: tc=tool-call rounds; ts=total invocations. Turns is defined as decoder forward passes emitting tool-call block (Sec5.1), best read as tool-emitting turns, not token-by-token forwards. UGS prompt permits only one tool at a time but lists multiple regions/queries in that tool; parallelism is intra-call batched retrieval, not unrestricted simultaneous tool types. Implementation counting of wrapper-call versus each subquery for ts is not shown. 5.3×=11.6/2.2 average rounds; no measured5.3× latency claim established.

judge_information.evaluation: Table18 supplies question,response,correct_answer and asks extraction/equivalence judgment, not solve. No explicit image/search-results input or necessity judgment. What response includes and exact judge identity are not specified.
judge_information.rl_reward: Racc binary correctness judge; full prompt/model of training judge not explicitly bound to Table18 (which is labeled benchmark evaluation). No evidence RL judge sees ground-truth regions or counterfactual no-search branches.
judge_information.data_quality: Gemini3.0Flash QA judge uses six dimensions; Qwen235B no-tool pass@1 filters solvable examples; trajectory quality discards duplicate/off-topic/ungrounded results. This is model curation, not independent gold.

unresolved_source_ambiguities: Eq4 uses -λred as penalty, AppE states λred=-0.1; literal substitution gives +0.1. Preserve conflict; intended negative penalty likely but unverified.
Table8/D evaluation0.0/1.0 conflicts with Table10 evaluation1.0/0.7. Training rollout0.8/.95 consistent. Exact evaluation deployment unknown.
E.4 names MAX_TOOL_CALLS_TURN=8 but prose says each rollout capped8 invocations and Table10 maxcalls8/maxturns9; per-turn/trajectory semantics and batched subqueries accounting not verified.
Sec3.2.3 ties RL data to PRS, while C.3 explicitly re-evaluates previously failed PRS queries with SFT and retains pass@1 failures/pass@5 successes. Record uses C.3 specific procedure.
Eq3 requires successful epoch minimum; no-success handling/tie resolution omitted; ts update may rise when shorter-round trajectory uses more total queries, so only tc monotonicity is explicit.
Fig5 shows12 tool rounds then final13 vs2 tool rounds then final3; captions/text compare12 vs3. Case mixes answer-including turns with tool-only rounds; not used as clean4× measurement.
F.1 prose FVQA66.6 differs Table13 value66.5; BCVL4 and6 tie36.1, not unique4 maximum. Claims of steadily declining FVQA are stronger than nonmonotonic table.
MainTable2 uses VDR published performance with local8B-SFT turns (AppD). Cross-backbone/toolchain comparisons cannot identify pure algorithm improvement or equal-size measured speedup.
Sec5.2 attributes235B improvement to TRACE+OPD but235B recipe hasTRACE only. F.3 distractor result is235B SFT, so it cannot validateTRACE/OPD robustness.
F.2 text claims strongest across all benchmarks; Fig4 has exceptions (235B CodeCrop BCVL50.3>UGS49.7; IMEB42.8>40.3), while average UGS wins.
